compiled_state.title: GREEN: add concurrent-invocation lock to ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add exclusive lock guard to ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.sh to prevent concurrent invocations from corrupting the SNAPSHOT backup or producing a half-rebuilt state.

Implementation:
- Acquire lock before any backup or SNAPSHOT modification (use flock or mkdir-based lock)
- Lock file path: use mktemp-style deterministic path, e.g. /tmp/ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.lock
- If lock cannot be acquired within 5 seconds: print 'migration already in progress — aborting' to stderr and exit 1
- Release lock on success, on failure, and on SIGINT/SIGTERM (trap for cleanup)

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: migration script invoked twice concurrently; When: second invocation runs while first holds lock; Then: second exits non-zero with 'migration already in progress' message
- Given: lock held; When: first invocation succeeds; Then: lock file is removed after completion
- Given: lock held; When: first invocation receives SIGINT; Then: lock file is removed in trap handler

depends_on: T14-pre (e3a9-9c01)
